title: Deeplus backend-neutral MIR R31 closure-capture-plan successor
description: R31 bounded design schema for Verified<DeeplusMirR1>. It adds a backend-neutral closure-environment plan table and enriches CLOSURE_MAKE while adding no operation or terminator kind and admitting no target projection, machine layout, API-visible value identity, product execution, or MIR-X1 authority.

traitAssociatedStaticSelectionDescriptor.description: Exact MIR residue of the statically selected <T as Trait>::item. This descriptor is data identity, not a runtime lookup recipe.

responsibilityEvidenceDescriptor.description: Exact backend-neutral value-level responsibility proof selected in typed HIR. It is disjoint from the callable responsibility_id profile.

responsibility_evidence_id_or_null.description: Exact ResponsibilityEvidenceId for COPY or CLONE; null for BORROW, INOUT, MOVE, and ONCE. The resolved descriptor owns the exact rule/evidence kind and Clone witness/error/effect/acquisition/cleanup residue.

cleanupRegionDecl.description: The two admitted flags constrain execution of a cleanup action itself. They do not forbid the owning cleanup scope from surviving SUSPEND or being drained by a terminal CANCEL leave.

closureMakePayload.x-deeplus-precondition: committed_construction_id names the BUILDER_COMMIT-complete environment for closure_environment_plan_id

x-deeplus-cross-field-contract.declared_envelope_nullability: declared_envelope is null exactly for IMPLICIT_EXACT_ROOT and INHERITED_SEALED_ROOT and non-null exactly for EXPLICIT_HEADER
x-deeplus-cross-field-contract.computed_envelope: normalized sorted-unique union of the exact transitive contributions
x-deeplus-cross-field-contract.local_compatibility: computed_envelope is a subset of effective_envelope on both axes
x-deeplus-cross-field-contract.family_subset: every child effective envelope is a subset of its family-root effective envelope
x-deeplus-cross-field-contract.contribution_trace_order: BASE_OWNER, then FIELD_OWNER in declaration order, then OWNER_DEF_CLEANUP; diagnostic/trace order only
x-deeplus-cross-field-contract.runtime_cleanup_order_unchanged: OWNER_DEF_CLEANUP, then own fields in reverse successful acquisition order, then BASE_OWNER
